notes: Adjudication against the second extraction (48 field disagreements): the AMS's two 6-pin ports stay connectivity.interface (as in the other AMS files; not also electrical.connector); compatibility stays scoped to the printer option value with the compat-targets kinds (family / printer; 'printer_family' and 'accessory' are not target kinds); count-dependent requirements stay scoped to their variant; the in-the-box list keeps the store's words ('PTFE Tube (185mm*2+225mm*2+900mm*1)', no derived quantity). Taken from the second: the X2D section's own 4-in-1 sentence and the intro guide's Switching Adapter sentence for X1/P1. Added: the Switching Adapter for multi-unit drying on P2S, H2S (2 or more), H2D/H2C and X2D, and not_published electrical.standby_power and printing.filament_odometry (the AMS 2 Pro sheet and table state neither; the AMS HT table on the same page lists odometry). Not added: a separate H2 Series Dedicated adapter relation on the whole H2D/H2C option (an adapter is needed only for 3+ units or 2 + external spool, and the H2D may use either version; recorded in the 3+ relation's note), and a not_compatible_with for the AMS (1st gen) 6-pin cable (the page only cautions that it 'may cause unstable communication between AMS and printer', which is advice, not a stated incompatibility, and it names no product: the store's 'Bambu Bus Cable' sells a '6pin (AMS to AMS/Hub/Buffer)' type without saying which AMS generation it belongs to).

Second adjudication pass, 2026-10-17 (every disputed value re-read in the cached spec sheet, the three wiki guides and the corpus store page, including its variant notes and the 4-in-1 PTFE Adapter page's options): no value changed. The X1/P1 Filament Buffer, the X1/P1 AMS Hub and the 4-in-1 PTFE Adapter rows stay on their variants because the guide ties them to a unit count ('When connecting 1 AMS …', '2 or more AMS units …', '3 or more AMS units …'), and an option-wide scope would also claim them for unit counts the guide does not tie them to (no 4-in-1 adapter for one H2S or A2L unit, for one or two P2S units, or for one or two H2D/H2C or X2D units without an external spool; two or more X1/P1 units take an AMS Hub, not a Filament Buffer). ams.slots keeps the guide's words 'four filament slots' (see its note); the quote checker's digit test cannot see a number written as a word.
